title: Convert inline CSS styles to Tailwind design system tokens
body: The exercises page uses React.CSSProperties inline styles. Convert to Tailwind classes using design system tokens (p-card-padding, bg-elevated-50, text-body-sm, etc.) for consistency with the rest of the admin UI.
rationale: Admin components should use the design system tokens for visual consistency. The page works but diverges from the project's styling conventions.
